jp: 先生[せんせい]{とて/といえども|tote}人間[にんげん]です{から/ので|kara-because}、間違[まちが]えること{も|mo-also}あります。
en: Even a teacher is only human, so they sometimes make mistakes.
why: とて concedes that even a teacher is no exception to the rule that people err.

jp: 親[おや]{とて/といえども|tote}完璧[かんぺき]で{は|wa-negative}ありません。
en: Even parents are not perfect.
why: Noun + とて means 'even X, too': X is no exception to the point that follows.

jp: 今[いま]さら謝[あやま]った{とて/としたところで|tote}、もう遅[おそ]い。
en: Even if you apologise now, it's too late.
why: Plain past verb + とて means 'even if you do it', and the result is negative or useless.

jp: どんなに急[いそ]いだ{としたところで/とて|tote}、間[ま]に合[あ]わなかっただろう。
en: However hard we had hurried, we would not have made it.
why: Verb + としたところで concedes an action and says it would have changed nothing.

jp: 子供[こども]{とて/といえども|tote}、悪[わる]いこと{を|o-object}すれ{ば|ba-conditional}叱[しか]られる。
en: Even a child gets scolded for doing something bad.
why: とて marks even a child as no exception to the rule that wrongdoing is scolded.

jp: 彼[かれ]{とて/といえども|tote}、最初[さいしょ]{は|wa-contrast}初心者[しょしんしゃ]だった。
en: Even he was a beginner at first.
why: とて says even this skilled person is no exception: everybody starts as a beginner.

jp: 王様[おうさま]{とて/といえども|tote}、法[ほう]{に|ni-target}従[したが]わなければならない。
en: Even a king must obey the law.
why: とて says that even the highest person is no exception to the obligation that follows.

jp: いくら努力[どりょく]した{とて/としたところで|tote}、結果[けっか]{は|wa-topic}変[か]わらない。
en: No matter how hard you try, the result won't change.
why: Verb + とて concedes the effort ('even if you try') and then denies that it matters.

jp: 誰[だれ]{とて|tote}、失敗[しっぱい]{は|wa-contrast}したくない。
en: Nobody, whoever they are, wants to fail.
why: 誰とて means 'anyone at all, without exception', so the sentence holds for everyone.

jp: 泣[な]いた{とて/としたところで|tote}、死[し]んだ人[ひと]{は/が|wa-topic}帰[かえ]ってこない。
en: Even if you cry, the dead don't come back.
why: Verb + とて means 'even if you do it' and then states that it achieves nothing.

jp: 私[わたし]{とて/といえども|tote}、迷[まよ]うこと{は/も|wa-contrast}あります。
en: Even I sometimes hesitate.
why: とて marks the speaker too as no exception: even I have moments of doubt.

jp: 金持[かねも]ち{とて/といえども|tote}、病気[びょうき]{に|ni-change}なること{は|wa-contrast}あるだろう。
en: Even rich people probably fall ill sometimes.
why: とて marks rich people as no exception to the fact that anyone can get sick.

jp: 天才[てんさい]{とて/といえども|tote}、一日[いちにち]{で|de-time-limit}上達[じょうたつ]{は|wa-negative}しない。
en: Even a genius doesn't improve in a single day.
why: とて says even a genius is no exception to the limit that improvement takes time.

jp: 動物[どうぶつ]{とて/といえども|tote}、痛[いた]み{を|o-object}感[かん]じる。
en: Even animals feel pain.
why: とて says even animals, which one might doubt, are no exception to feeling pain.

jp: 雨[あめ]{が|ga-subject}降[ふ]った{とて/としたところで|tote}、試合[しあい]{は|wa-topic}中止[ちゅうし]{に|ni-change}なりません。
en: Even if it rains, the match will not be cancelled.
why: Verb + とて means 'even if it rains', and the main clause says the outcome stays the same.

jp: 何[なに]{を|o-object}言[い]われた{とて/としたところで|tote}、私[わたし]{は|wa-topic}意見[いけん]{を|o-object}変[か]えない。
en: Whatever I am told, I won't change my opinion.
why: Verb + とて means 'even if (you say anything)'; the speaker's opinion stays fixed regardless.

jp: いくら有名[ゆうめい]だ{とて/としたところで|tote}、マナー{を|o-object}守[まも]らない人[ひと]{は|wa-topic}困[こま]る。
en: However famous someone is, people who ignore manners are a problem.
why: とて concedes the person's fame ('however famous') and says it does not excuse bad manners.

jp: 老人[ろうじん]{とて/といえども|tote}、社会[しゃかい]{の|no-possessive}一員[いちいん]です。
en: Even the elderly are members of society.
why: とて says that even the elderly are no exception to being part of society.

jp: 彼女[かのじょ]{とて/といえども|tote}、人[ひと]{に|passive-agent}知[し]られたくない過去[かこ]{は/も|wa-contrast}あるでしょう。
en: Even she probably has a past she doesn't want people to know about.
why: とて marks even this seemingly flawless person as no exception.

jp: 名医[めいい]{とて/といえども|tote}、治[なお]せない病気[びょうき]{は/も|wa-contrast}ある。
en: Even a famous doctor cannot cure every illness.
why: とて says even an excellent doctor is no exception to the limits of medicine.

jp: 社長[しゃちょう]{とて/といえども|tote}、法律[ほうりつ]{を|o-object}破[やぶ]れ{ば|ba-conditional}罰[ばっ]せられる。
en: Even a company president is punished for breaking the law.
why: とて says even the president is no exception: breaking the law brings punishment.
